changes.title: Configuration/OpenAIApi replaced by the OpenAI client class
changes.description: In openai-node v4, the Configuration + OpenAIApi pair was removed. The SDK exports a default OpenAI class constructed directly with options: `new OpenAI({ apiKey })`. Named imports `Configuration` and `OpenAIApi` no longer exist.

detect.notes: The import line and the two construction lines typically appear together; migrate them as one unit. The dependency floor must move to openai ^4 in package.json — record that file in the manifest.

replace.guidance: Replace `import { Configuration, OpenAIApi } from "openai"` with `import OpenAI from "openai"`. Replace the Configuration + OpenAIApi construction with `const openai = new OpenAI({ apiKey: ... })`. Update the `openai` dependency in package.json to `^4.0.0` and record package.json in the manifest.
replace.after:
import OpenAI from "openai";
const openai = new OpenAI({ apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY });

changes.title: createX methods replaced by resource namespaces
changes.description: v4 moved every createX method onto resource namespaces: createChatCompletion → chat.completions.create, createCompletion → completions.create, createEmbedding → embeddings.create, createImage → images.generate. Request params are unchanged for chat/completions/embeddings.

detect.notes: Pair each rename with rule openai-v4-003: v4 methods return the payload directly (no axios response wrapper).

replace.guidance: Rename the method per the mapping (createChatCompletion → chat.completions.create, createCompletion → completions.create, createEmbedding → embeddings.create, createImage → images.generate), keeping arguments as-is.
replace.before: const response = await openai.createChatCompletion({ model, messages });
replace.after: const completion = await openai.chat.completions.create({ model, messages });

changes.title: Axios response wrapper removed — no more .data indirection
changes.description: v3 returned axios responses, so payloads lived under `.data` (e.g. `response.data.choices`, and embeddings doubly nested as `response.data.data[0]`). v4 returns the API payload directly: `completion.choices`, `embedding.data[0]`.

detect.notes: Only applies to responses from the openai client. `.data` on unrelated axios calls must not be touched.

replace.guidance: Drop exactly one `.data` level on openai responses: `response.data.choices` → `response.choices`; `response.data.data[0].embedding` → `response.data[0].embedding`.
